name: Passion Fruit, Tamarind & Lime
desc: Brisk passion fruit acidity meets dark tangy tamarind and restrained lime.
ing: 190 g unsweetened seedless passion fruit purée
80 g ripe papaya, peeled and deseeded
1 tsp smooth unsweetened tamarind concentrate, seed-free
140 ml coconut water, no added sugar
Cold water, as needed to reach 800–850 ml TOTAL contents (not extra)
method: Use chilled fresh, canned-in-juice or unsweetened puréed fruit. Thoroughly remove all fruit stones, inedible skins and hard seeds. Use seedless purées for soursop, guava, passion fruit and calamansi.

Place the fruit, liquids and other ingredients in your 1-litre Morphy Richards soup maker. Add enough chilled water for the combined contents to reach 800–850 ml in the jug, never below MIN or above MAX.
Use only the UNHEATED Drinks/Blend programme for approximately 2 minutes. Never use a heated soup programme.
Taste and adjust texture with a little water if needed; refrigerate promptly and drink fresh.
science: The fruit supplies varied vitamins, fibre and natural plant pigments; no nutritional totals are claimed before calculation.
note: Project 400 · Tropical & exotic · ££ · Spring · Idea to try, not kitchen-tested. Some fruit requires specialist sourcing, but no freezer or hob. ID P400-039.
